prayerExcerpt.en-US: To restore all things in Christ.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Restaurar todas as coisas em Cristo.

meta.face: A man of about seventy with a broad, handsome, open face and strong clear-cut features, clean-shaven, thick short silver-white hair under the white zucchetto, clear light eyes under straight brows and a kind, winning smile.
meta.basis: His photographs as pope, and witnesses quoted by Forbes (1918): a 'handsome open face and strong clear-cut features', eyes full of light and a 'winning smile'. The Host and the child stand for his decree on early First Communion.

sources.title: Wikimedia Commons, Pius X, photograph by Ernest Walter Histed
